title: He Whakatūpato Iti i mua i te Hoia Hīkoi
intro: Eke atu ki tētahi awaawa kei reira tētahi rangatira nui me tētahi ope nui e whakatata mai ana, ka whakaarohia tētahi kaihaerere iti e tuku ana i tētahi whakatūpato e whakaora ana i tētahi hapori katoa. I te taenga atu o te hapori e mōrearea ana ki tētahi piringa, ka pahemo atu te tūpono. Whāia ngā tohu hei tautuhi i te āhua i ngaro i muri i taua whakatūpato.
clues: Kei roto ahau i ngā mea hanga ririki e hono ana ki te rangatiratanga o tētahi rangatira.
E noho ana tōku hapori i roto i ngā whare i roto i te awaawa, ka taea e tētahi o tātou te karanga ki tētahi atu.
Kei te tūtaki tātou ki tētahi tūmomo whakawehi mai i taua rangatira me ngā taua e haere tahi ana me ia.
Ko au te tangata e karanga ana i taku hapori kia tomo ki roto i ō rātou kāinga, e whakatūpato ana hoki i a tātou kia kaua e tukinotia tātou me te kore mōhio.
Ko Sulayman te rangatira, ā, ko tōku momo kei roto i ngā mea hanga i raro i tana mana.
Ko ahau te pōpokorua o taua awaawa; i muri i taku whakatūpato, ka tomo mātou ki ō mātou kāinga, ā, ka mawhiti atu i te kuru e kore nei e mōhiotia e mātou.

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
